branch.name: Files & Documents
branch.summary: Finding, reading, writing and organizing files and documents: the local filesystem, Google Drive, Notion, Confluence, and PDF/Office document tools (extract text or tables, convert formats, merge/split PDFs, edit Word/Excel files).

toolkits.name: Filesystem
toolkits.summary: Read, write, edit, list, move and search files and directories on the local machine, restricted to allowed directories.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file. Use the 'head' parameter to read only the first N lines of a file, or the 'tail' parameter to read only the last N lines of a file. Only works within allowed directories.

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. This is more efficient than reading files one by one when you need to analyze or compare multiple files. Each file's content is returned with its path as a reference. Failed reads for individual files won't stop the entire operation. Only works within allowed directories.

paths.description: Paths of the files to read

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Handles text content with proper encoding. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces exact line sequences with new content. Returns a git-style diff showing the changes made. Only works within allowed directories.

oldText.description: Text to search for - must match exactly

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists. Can create multiple nested directories in one operation. If the directory already exists, this operation will succeed silently. Perfect for setting up directory structures for projects or ensuring required paths exist. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results clearly distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes. This tool is essential for understanding directory structure and finding specific files within a directory. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure. Each entry includes 'name', 'type' (file/directory), and 'children' for directories. Files have no children array, while directories always have a children array (which may be empty). The output is formatted with 2-space indentation for readability. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Can move files between directories and rename them in a single operation. If the destination exists, the operation will fail. Works across different directories and can be used for simple renaming within the same directory. Both source and destination must be within allowed directories.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Searches through all subdirectories from the starting path. The search is case-insensitive and matches partial names. Returns full paths to all matching items. Great for finding files when you don't know their exact location. Only searches within allowed directories.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory. Returns comprehensive information including size, creation time, last modified time, permissions, and type. This tool is perfect for understanding file characteristics without reading the actual content. Only works within allowed directories.

path.description: Path to the file or directory

toolkits.name: Google Drive
toolkits.summary: Search, read, upload, organize, share and export files in Google Drive (including Docs, Sheets and Slides).

tools.name: gdrive_search
tools.description: Search for files in Google Drive

pageToken.description: Token for the next page of results

tools.name: gdrive_read_file
tools.description: Read contents of a file from Google Drive. Google Docs are exported as Markdown, Sheets as CSV, Presentations as plain text, Drawings as PNG; other files are returned as text or base64.

fileId.description: ID of the Google Drive file

tools.name: gdrive_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local file (or inline text content) to Google Drive, optionally converting it to a native Google Docs format.

name.description: Name of the file in Drive

local_path.description: Path of a local file to upload

content.description: Inline text content to upload instead of a local file

mime_type.description: MIME type of the uploaded content

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the destination folder (defaults to My Drive root)

convert.description: Convert to the corresponding Google format (Docs/Sheets/Slides)

tools.name: gdrive_create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in Google Drive.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID (defaults to My Drive root)

tools.name: gdrive_move_file
tools.description: Move a file to another folder

file_id.description: ID of the Google Drive file

remove_from_current.description: Remove the file from its current parent folders

tools.name: gdrive_share_file
tools.description: Share a Google Drive file or folder by granting a permission to a user, group, domain or anyone with the link.

file_id.description: ID of the Google Drive file

emailAddress.description: Email for user or group grantees

allowFileDiscovery.description: For domain/anyone: whether the file can be found via search

email_message.description: Custom message included in the notification email

expiration_time.description: RFC 3339 time at which the permission expires

tools.name: gdrive_export_file
tools.description: Export a Google Workspace document (Doc, Sheet, Slides) to another format such as PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV or plain text, and save it locally.

file_id.description: ID of the Google Drive file

save_to.description: Local path to write the exported file to

toolkits.name: Notion
toolkits.summary: Search, read, create and update pages and databases in a Notion workspace, and comment on pages.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Perform a search over: - "internal": Semantic search over Notion workspace and connected sources (Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Jira, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Linear). Supports filtering by creation date and creator. - "user": Search for users by name or email. Auto-selects AI search (with connected sources) or workspace search (workspace-only, faster) based on user's access to Notion AI. Use content_search_mode to override.

query.description: Semantic search query over your entire Notion workspace and connected sources

filters.description: Optional filters to apply to the search results

created_date_range.description: Restrict to content created in this range

created_by_user_ids.description: Restrict to content created by these users

page_url.description: Optionally, search within a specific page and its children

teamspace_id.description: Optionally, search within a specific teamspace

data_source_url.description: Optionally, search within a specific database data source (collection://...)

tools.name: notion_fetch
tools.description: Retrieves details about a Notion entity (page or database) by URL or ID. Returns the page content in Notion-flavored Markdown along with its properties.

id.description: The ID or URL of the Notion page or database to fetch

tools.name: notion_create_pages
tools.description: Creates one or more Notion pages with specified properties and content. If a parent is not specified, pages are created as standalone workspace-level private pages. To add a row to a database, pass the database (data source) as the parent and set properties matching its schema.

properties.description: Page properties. For pages under a database these must match the database schema; otherwise only 'title' is allowed.

tools.name: notion_update_page
tools.description: Update a Notion page's properties or content.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to update

selection_with_ellipsis.description: Unique start and end snippet of the content to replace or insert after, e.g. '# Section...last line'

tools.name: notion_query_database
tools.description: Query a database

timestamp.description: Sort by timestamp instead of property

tools.name: notion_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a page or reply in an existing discussion thread.

page_id.description: ID of the page to comment on

discussion_id.description: Reply in this discussion thread instead of starting a new one

rich_text.description: Comment content as Notion rich text

toolkits.name: Confluence
toolkits.summary: Search, read, create and update Confluence wiki pages and comments.

tools.name: confluence_search
tools.description: Search Confluence content using simple terms or CQL.

query.description: Search query - can be either a simple text (e.g. 'project documentation') or a CQL query string. Simple queries use 'siteSearch' by default. Examples of CQL: 'type=page AND space=DEV', 'title~"Meeting Notes"', 'label=documentation', 'lastModified > startOfMonth("-1M")'

spaces_filter.description: Comma-separated list of space keys to filter results by

tools.name: confluence_get_page
tools.description: Get content of a specific Confluence page by its ID, or by its title and space key.

page_id.description: Confluence page ID (numeric ID, can be found in the page URL)

title.description: The exact title of the page. Use with space_key if page_id is not known.

space_key.description: The key of the space. Required if using title.

include_metadata.description: Whether to include page metadata such as creation date, last update, version, and labels

convert_to_markdown.description: Whether to convert page to markdown (true) or keep it in raw storage format (false)

tools.name: confluence_get_page_children
tools.description: Get child pages of a specific Confluence page.

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent page whose children you want to retrieve

expand.description: Fields to expand in the response (e.g., 'version', 'body.storage')

limit.description: Maximum number of child pages to return (1-50)

include_content.description: Whether to include the page content in the response

convert_to_markdown.description: Whether to convert page content to markdown

tools.name: confluence_create_page
tools.description: Create a new Confluence page.

space_key.description: The key of the space to create the page in (usually a short uppercase code like 'DEV', 'TEAM', or 'DOC')

content.description: The content of the page. Format depends on content_format parameter.

parent_id.description: Optional parent page ID. If provided, this page will be created as a child of the specified page

content_format.description: The format of the content parameter

enable_heading_anchors.description: Whether to enable automatic heading anchor generation (only applies when content_format is 'markdown')

tools.name: confluence_update_page
tools.description: Update an existing Confluence page. The full new content must be provided; it replaces the existing body.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to update

title.description: The new title of the page

content.description: The new content of the page. Format depends on content_format parameter.

is_minor_edit.description: Whether this is a minor edit

parent_id.description: Optional the new parent page ID

content_format.description: The format of the content parameter

tools.name: confluence_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Confluence page.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to add a comment to

content.description: The comment content in Markdown format

toolkits.name: PDF Tools
toolkits.summary: Local PDF utilities: extract text (with OCR) and tables, merge, split, and read metadata.

tools.name: pdf_extract_text
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF file. Supports page ranges and OCR for scanned/image-only PDFs.

pages.description: Pages to extract, e.g. '1-3,7'. Defaults to all pages.

ocr.description: Run OCR on pages without a text layer

ocr_language.description: Tesseract language code(s) for OCR, e.g. 'eng' or 'eng+deu'

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge multiple PDF files into one.

input_paths.description: PDF files to merge, in order

add_bookmarks.description: Add a bookmark for each input file

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Split a PDF into separate files by page range.

ranges.description: Page ranges, one output file per range, e.g. ['1-3', '4-12']

output_dir.description: Directory for the output files (defaults to the input's directory)

tools.name: pdf_get_metadata
tools.description: PDF info (pages, author, title, etc).

tools.name: pdf_extract_tables
tools.description: Detect and extract tables from PDF pages.

flavor.description: Extraction strategy: 'lattice' for ruled tables, 'stream' for whitespace-separated

toolkits.name: Office Documents
toolkits.summary: Convert documents between formats (pandoc, MarkItDown) and work with Word and Excel files.

tools.name: convert_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a resource described by an http:, https:, file: or data: URI to markdown. Supports PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, EPUB, ZIP archives, images (EXIF metadata and OCR) and audio (transcription).

uri.description: URI of the resource to convert, e.g. file:///home/me/report.docx

tools.name: convert_contents
tools.description: Converts content between different formats. Transforms input content from any supported format into the specified output format. Supported formats: markdown, html, pdf, docx, rst, latex, epub, txt, ipynb, odt. PDF output requires a TeX engine. For pdf, docx, rst, latex, epub and odt output, output_file is required.

contents.description: The content to be converted (must be provided if input_file is not)

input_file.description: Complete path to input file including filename and extension

output_file.description: Complete path where to save the output including filename and extension

reference_doc.description: Path to a reference .docx whose styles are used for docx output

metadata.description: Document metadata such as title, author, date

tools.name: read_data_from_excel
tools.description: Read data from Excel worksheet.

end_cell.description: Ending cell (optional, auto-expands if not provided)

tools.name: docx_search_and_replace
tools.description: Search for text and replace all occurrences in a Word document.
